SELECT -- 当前学年 SUM(CASE WHEN create_time BETWEEN CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH)), '-09-01') AND DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH)), '-09-01'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curStudentTotal,
SUM(CASE WHEN create_time BETWEEN CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH)), '-09-01') AND DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH)), '-09-01'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curInStudentTotal,
-- 上一学年 SUM(CASE WHEN create_time BETWEEN CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 20 MONTH)), '-09-01') AND DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 20 MONTH)), '-09-01'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastStudentTotal,
SUM(CASE WHEN create_time BETWEEN CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 20 MONTH)), '-09-01') AND DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 20 MONTH)), '-09-01'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastInStudentTotal,
-- 全量统计 COUNT(id) AS studentTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inStudentTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS suspendStudentTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS quitStudentTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS changeStudentTotal FROM student_archive
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS ratio FROM student_archive GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m') AS period, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student_archive WHERE change_reason IS NOT NULL AND change_reason != '' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY period
